recap.text: War Leader Arief is a beardless level 80 Semeru dwarf in a samurai-like vest and his great-great-grandfather's hat. He leads the Larracos Defense Force Infantry and calls himself an NPC. Arief guides the party through Larracos, explains the flooding of its sixty-six levels, and guards the door during Louis's marriage to Juice Box. He controls a dwarven digger to waylay the god Harpocrates.

beats.headline: His great-great-grandfather's hat
beats.text: Intake record. At the foot of the college stairs a dwarf officer, star over his head, feeds jerky to Mongo and Rend. Squat, young, beardless, a long thin moustache; samurai-like vest flaring like a bell, feathers straight up from his helmet, a wide sickle on his back, every piece enchanted. He bows. Honored Warlords. Crawler Donut loves his hat; it was his great-great-grandfather's. War Leader Arief, level 80 Semeru dwarf, commander of the Larracos Defense Force Infantry. Status: Despondent. His goddess is dead, and he cannot worship another.
beats.gist: War Leader Arief is a despondent level 80 Semeru dwarf commander of the Larracos Defense Force Infantry.

beats.headline: In the traditional manner
beats.text: Crawler Donut asks in chat whether this nice dwarf knows who flooded his city, and who killed his goddess. Crawler Carl tells her not to bring it up. Arief, meanwhile, is the first NPC Carl has heard call himself an NPC out loud. Juice Box wants Carl privately first. And, turning to Louis with another bow, she would like to solidify the great truce in the traditional manner. Through marriage. They would like to get it over with right away.
beats.gist: Donut asks Arief who flooded his city. Carl tells her not to bring it up.

beats.headline: Sixty-six levels, counted upward
beats.text: Guided tour. Larracos has sixty-six levels, Arief says, not all full rings, numbered from the bottom: the college is on fifty, homes on forty-nine. The water reached level 39, drained to 29 and clogged, and Juice Box had it kept that way; it now sits at level 3, just over the castle's highest tower. His uncle drained the Piccadilly theatre and found it full of jellyfish. The glowing things at the ramp corners are explosives, in case the enemy gets in. There are some on every other down ramp.
beats.gist: Arief says Larracos has sixty-six levels, and the water now sits at level 3.

beats.headline: There was another season
beats.text: Arief mentions another season, when orcs marched down the streets and Reavers jumped in. Crawler Carl stops in the road. Arief does not remember it himself; he believes he is new, like most of them. His uncle remembers dozens of seasons, is one of the Jatismara, and sits on Juice Box's war council. Most of them know about their past lives. Asked by Britney whether his uncle remembers dying: no. For most of them, Arief believes, one death is forever.
beats.gist: Arief mentions a season of orcs and Reavers, but believes he is new.

beats.headline: Revenge on Architect Houston
beats.text: Arief pulls the curved blade off his back with a shing, and everyone jumps, Mongo included. When the fighting starts, he says, he takes his revenge on Architect Houston, leader of the Madness, who caught his brother sabotaging their fortifications. His brother was tortured, they say, before Juice Box got in and ended his suffering. The raids bloodied every enemy camp and got inside every inner circle but the nagas', he adds: a court of assassins, where no changeling or spy has ever got in, and where even Juice Box does not try.
beats.gist: Arief pulls a curved blade off his back and seeks revenge on Architect Houston.

beats.headline: Guarding the door
beats.text: Arief leads the party down past flooded shops and through a panel in a kitchen wall to a hidden tunnel, and stands guard at the door while Juice Box lays her papers out. When Juice Box greets Louis with a kiss that does not stop, Crawler Carl exchanges a look with the dwarf at the door, who seems as sceptical as he is. The wedding itself is small and fast, and Arief guards that door too.
beats.gist: Arief leads the party past flooded shops and through a kitchen wall to a hidden tunnel.

beats.headline: On the relay
beats.text: Operations note. The spies sent into naga territory are a pair of changelings, and Crawler Carl cannot speak to them directly. Every message goes from Carl to Britney, and from Britney to either Juice Box or Arief of the Semeru. Britney has become the crawlers' main liaison with the NPC team, and the dwarf is one of the two hands at the other end of it.
beats.gist: Messages go from Carl to Britney, then to Juice Box or Arief of the Semeru.

beats.headline: The diggers answer to him
beats.text: Harpocrates, a god, is going after the crawlers' friends, and Crawler Carl wants the dwarven digger under the Dream's castle turned on him. The giant robots have done nothing yet. Britney relays: Arief controls them while Juice Box is away, and she asks him. The digger comes. Harpocrates, who had turned back toward Donut, is waylaid by one of the diggers, which Carl has still not actually seen.
beats.gist: Britney asks Arief to turn a dwarven digger on Harpocrates to protect Donut.
